entries.land_description: Two Towers... I own a farm, live on it and work it somewhat. I raise animals and have a . 1 acre garden... 1... 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing (cold running water only)/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, (males)
entries.notes: I welcome visitors, especially lesbians as I am quite isolated, but I do not forbid males of any age access IF known to me or with wimmin. There is camping space galore. If the visit is over 1 night I ask for a $2 fee (I trade)/night per person to defray my costs (water, toilet paper, produce, etc). Drugs in moderation are fine. No proselytizing please. Extended visits (over 1 week) need to be decided in person.

entries.land_description: WWLC owns DOE (Daughters of Earth) Farm; half wooded campground, half hayfield, orchard, garden, berries, etc in West Central Wisconsin. The land is hilly, secluded, very beautiful... 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl children, boy children 'til age of 2, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: Four womyn live here year 'round, more in summer. Some of the campground chemical free space. Camping equipment available if needed. Sliding scale fees.

entries.land_description: We are consciously creating a space in which to live our lesbian reality in harmony with the natural world. Primitive camping here is open to wimmin. We hope to build a community focused on interdependent care toward the healing and health of us all... 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/ electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl and boy children by arrangement, differently abled
entries.notes: Chemically free, no pets, no guns, no men.

entries.land_description: A new social alternative for lesbians and gay men on holiday. Tipi lodgings ($11/night) or campsite ($7/night). Some weeks are for womyn only... 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl and boy children, gay males
entries.notes: We provide food service ($11/night), hot tub, sports facilities, firewood and basic conveniences. Close by: swimming, boating, etc. Reservations preferred.

entries.land_description: The land is a combination of woods, meadows, and rocky bluffs. We have a creek and springs... 90 acres, camping space, woods.
entries.notes: Long-term plans include: cabins for our personal use, additional cabins and camping sites for use by visiting women (by pre-arrangement only), and some farming. Emphasis on solar and appropriate technology and on developing a place that nurtures the female principle.

entries.land_description: Lots of land 2 hours north of SF... 167 acres, camping space, woods and meadows, farm land (grazing).
entries.notes: YWLC seeking 2 lesbian-feminists for new group. Old group (save one) needs to sell. Needs committment, money and respect. Into building living space, relationship, feminism. Not into drug abuse or S&M. Send name, address and phone for full details. Issues & money still negotiable.

entries.land_description: Privately Woman owned land open to camping and events June-Sept... 500 acres, housing/permanent structures limited to workers, plumbing, outhouses, camping space, woods, farm land, cook out grills, creek on land, near Russian River, women living and working on the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members, girl children, boy children under 10, nonlesbian women, dogs, horses
entries.notes: Horses boarded, workers welcomed. Daily and weekly rates and special event rates $5/day and up.

entries.land_description: A thriving womyn's community and retreat located 3 hours north of SF and close to the ocean. 160 acres of redwood-covered slopes, open grassy meadows, waterfalls, and pools for reflection. Nine structures including a communal kitchen, guesthouse, and bath house, look out over surrounding valleys and hills. A vegetable and flower garden, an herb garden, and an orchard... 60 acres, 10 housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity with generator, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women (possibly)
entries.notes: We began as an older womyn's community. We are now womyn of diverse ages, races and backgrounds, looking for permanent members (especially lesbians over 50). Visitors $5/night (exceptions: working class/older/third world women).
